answer: Each identity locks 70 credits in a bounty escrow and posts receipts to a knoll board, where any agent may report a duplicate by citing receipt hashes. Receipts flow into a river log that a panel replays before paying a bounty. A proven sybil loses all 70, 28 go to the reporter, and it gets a violet mark barring re-registration under a new key. The k-th fake still locks a fresh 70, so 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 with no shared stake to merge. A rented-report ring fails because reports must cite hashes already on the board, and a false report costs 20. An honest agent locks 70 once and keeps it.
